mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (from_user_id, to_user_id, content) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT x.other_id AS otherId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS otherName, u.avatar AS otherAvatar, m.content AS lastContent, m.create_time AS lastTime, COALESCE(c.unread, 0) AS unread FROM ( SELECT t.other_id, MAX(t.id) AS last_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END AS other_id, id FROM message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} ) t GROUP BY t.other_id ) x JOIN message m ON m.id = x.last_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = x.other_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT from_user_id AS other_id, COUNT(*) AS unread FROM message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY from_user_id ) c ON c.other_id = x.other_id ORDER BY x.last_id DESC
SELECT * FROM message WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{otherId}) OR (from_user_id = #{otherId} AND to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{otherId}) OR (from_user_id = #{otherId} AND to_user_id = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND from_user_id = #{otherId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId}
